description: This file defines the Test::Coocook Perl module, which provides a test harness for the Coocook web application. It includes methods for simulating user interactions, managing emails, reloading configuration, and verifying HTTP responses, specifically tailored for testing the Coocook application.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A Perl module providing a testing framework for the Coocook web application, including methods for simulating user actions, managing emails, and verifying HTTP responses.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object, initializing the test environment and configuration.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and logs request/response details if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: emails
methods.description: Returns the list of emails that have been sent during the test.

methods.name: clear_emails
methods.description: Clears the stored emails and resets the email counter.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Removes a specified number of emails from the beginning of the email list.

methods.name: emails_count_is
methods.description: Asserts that the number of stored emails matches the expected count.

methods.name: local_config_guard
methods.description: Provides a guard object that restores the original configuration when it goes out of scope.

methods.name: reload_config
methods.description: Reloads the application's configuration, either as an instance or class method.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema associated with the application.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Simulates a successful user registration with given field values.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Tests registration failure with expected error regex.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds a URL in the email matching a regex and performs a GET request on it, optionally checking the response status.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Checks that the email body contains a match for the given regex.

methods.name: email_unlike
methods.description: Checks that the email body does not contain a match for the given regex.

methods.name: _email_un_like
methods.description: Internal method to perform email content matching or non-matching assertions.

methods.name: _get_email_body
methods.description: Retrieves the body of the first stored email.

methods.name: is_logged_in
methods.description: Verifies that the client is logged in by checking page content.

methods.name: is_logged_out
methods.description: Verifies that the client is logged out by checking page content.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login action with provided username and password.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login and verifies success.

methods.name: login_fails
methods.description: Verifies that login fails with given credentials.

methods.name: logout_ok
methods.description: Performs a logout action.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes the display name and verifies success.

methods.name: request_recovery_link_ok
methods.description: Requests a password recovery link for a given email and verifies the process.

methods.name: create_project_ok
methods.description: Creates a new project with specified fields and verifies creation.

methods.name: checkbox_is_on
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox is checked.

methods.name: checkbox_is_off
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox is unchecked.

methods.name: _checkbox_is_on_off
methods.description: Internal method to verify checkbox state.

methods.name: input_has_value
methods.description: Verifies that an input element has a specific value.

methods.name: json_is
methods.description: Verifies that the response content matches expected JSON data.

methods.name: post_json
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON-encoded data.

methods.name: redirect_is
methods.description: Verifies that a URL redirects to an expected location with a specific status code.

methods.name: reload_ok
methods.description: Performs a reload of the page and verifies success.

methods.name: robots_flags_ok
methods.description: Checks the 'robots' meta tag for specific flags.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Verifies the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: status_like
methods.description: Verifies the response status code matches a regex.

methods.name: submit_form_fails
methods.description: Submits a form expecting failure (e.g., 400 status).
